title: Nobody is warned before the help box AI answers stop for the month
what: Quick AI answers to help questions are paid from a monthly ceiling of 80 dollars. When the ceiling is reached the answers just stop for every member until the next month. The only trace is a line in the server log. Nothing tells MettleUp it is getting close or has been reached.
expected: A warning to MettleUp at about 80 percent of the monthly ceiling and again when it is reached, so the team can raise it or answer questions by hand.
how_often: once the monthly ceiling is reached
fix_line: Send the team a warning when the monthly AI help spend passes 80 percent and when it hits the ceiling

title: When all members together reach the day's speaking limit, each member is told he spoke too much, and nobody at MettleUp is warned
what: Turning spoken feedback into text has a daily limit of 1,000 clips for everyone together, plus 20 per phone. When the shared limit is reached, a member who has not spoken at all today reads "You have spoken a lot today". No count of clips is shown to the team, and no warning goes out before or at the limit.
expected: A member who hit the shared limit reads that speaking is busy today and can type instead. The team gets a warning near and at the shared daily limit.
how_often: on busy days once the shared limit is reached
fix_line: Tell apart the shared limit from the per-phone one in the words, and warn the team near and at the shared limit

title: Once 1,000 help messages arrive in a day, every member's message is refused and nobody at MettleUp is warned
what: The help and feedback box takes at most 1,000 messages a day from everyone together. After that every member who writes in, even about a real problem, reads "Too many messages today" and the message is not saved. There is no warning to the team before or when this happens.
expected: The team is warned well before the shared daily limit, and a message over the limit is kept on the phone and sent again later instead of being lost.
how_often: on any day the shared limit is reached, including from spam
fix_line: Warn the team near the shared daily limit and let the phone keep and resend a refused message
